decisions.reason: The formwork profile system builds closely on the firm's existing machinery and formwork knowledge, and its dedicated website page indicates promising early results that the firm can interpret and improve.

Only mentioned rather than given a dedicated page, suggesting weaker early results, and as a relatively simple magnet block it may not build sufficiently on the firm's core knowledge to warrant further investment.
Presented on its own page, this magnetic formwork component appears core to the firm's new product line, where related knowledge supports learning and commercial improvement.

Merely mentioned and similar to other magnetic components, it shows limited early traction and likely falls outside the firm's strongest related knowledge, making it difficult to assimilate and improve.
